Two worlds, drawn as soft regions that blend where they meet; the blend is the boundary. A block of work is covered by a tool when the tool covers every feature the block needs: within 2× of the best tool on this device for a measured feature, 4 of 5 for a rubric one (italic: the author's judgement). Same rule for every tool; a dashed block is one no tool covers on this device. A tool's shape is the rounded convex hull of the blocks it covers and never encloses a block it does not cover (where one hull would, the tool is drawn in two or more pieces). Arrays cross zero-copy between raptor and CuPy, PyTorch, NVIDIA Warp and NumPy today (JAX foreseen). The tools are complementary; overlap is not a ranking.

Two worlds, drawn as soft regions that blend where they meet; the blend is the boundary. A block of work is covered by a tool when the tool covers every feature the block needs: within 2× of the best tool on this device for a measured feature, 4 of 5 for a rubric one (italic: the author's judgement). Same rule for every tool; a dashed block is one no tool covers on this device. A tool's shape is the rounded convex hull of the blocks it covers and never encloses a block it does not cover (where one hull would, the tool is drawn in two or more pieces). Arrays cross zero-copy between raptor and CuPy, PyTorch, NVIDIA Warp and NumPy today (JAX foreseen). The tools are complementary; overlap is not a ranking.
